scope.interpretation: The manifest enumerates all 105 available source records. Exactly 103 remain after removing the two IDs with eligible AGILLM simulator port training. This is an explicit set difference, not an invented 103-total source list.

comparability.validity: Successful record, fixed endpoint, finite AR/SAT/NAT, causality passed, zero skipped updates, recorded simulator hash matches.
limits: Adapted small simulator, not full-scale results.
Historical run files store only a 16-character simulator hash, no per-run plugin/data hashes.
Current source/data hashes cannot retroactively prove historical bytes.
Full, LR, LRK and head-normalized variants are not additional upstream architectures.
Timing and port adaptations differ; do not call these measured full-scale equal-compute results.
The AR-only byte-level CPU screen has different tokenization, objectives, precision and budgets; losses are not directly comparable.
